tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor sras mchog byin gyis brlab cing bskyed pa ni/1$0000300

sras phur gu gul gyis bdug la/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya su ru su ru pra su ru a dhiṣṭha mug mug ha la ha la dgra bgegs 'byung po'i tsitta myags mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ yungs dkar gyis brab cing*/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya ma gu ta la ma gu ta la pra ta la pra ta la sha ta rā tsa hūm̐ dgra bgegs 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ rakta byug cing*/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la maṇḍa la raksha raksha dgra bgegs wa shaṃ ku ru mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ gdug pa can rnams la thugs 'khrugs shing khams gsum gyi 'gro ba la rjes su chags par gyur par bsam la phur stegs su bzhag / bdag nyid dpal chen por gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas par zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po g.yon par nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mūṃ dmar po/ g.yas kyi sor mo lnga la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sran ma bkas pa tsam lnga'i steng du oṃ hūm̐ swā āṃḥhā/ g.yon gyi sor mo lnga la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sran ma bkas pa tsam lnga'i steng du mūṃ lāṃ māṃ pāṃ tāṃ/ yig 'bru rnams 'od du zhu ba las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ de las rigs lnga yab yum bcur lam gyis gsal bar gyur/ oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā sogs kyis phur bu stong par sbyang*/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes yab rnams kyis bskul/ sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes yum rnams kyis bskul/ thal mo ka pu tas phur bu bzung*/ badzra añdza li/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi 'od zer gyis phur pa dkar ltem gyis zhu nas yi ge hūm̐ mthing gar gyur/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐ yig yongs su gyur pa las khro bo mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas phur bu dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum rno dbal ngar dang ldan pa/ mgar gyi sol me nas bton pa lta bu me yi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ de'i rgya mdud gong ma la hūm̐ kā ra/

bcum gzhog brgyad la khro bo brgyad/ rgya mdud 'og ma la stobs po che ste khro bcu yab yum khra thabs dang bcas pa/ rgya mdud 'og ma'i logs bzhi la sgo ma bzhi/ chu srin gyi 'og tu skyes bu ging bzhi/ dbal gsum la phur srung bcu gnyis rnams gsal bar gyur/ bdag dang sras mchog gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang khro chung mthing nag nas tsam pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs shing zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa/ kī la ya yi sgra di ri ri sgrog pas bar mtshams med par gtams par gyur/ tshul 'di phur pa'i zab gnad thun min du song gshis phur pa'i las byang phal mo cher dkyus su ma bstan par gud du sbas pa'i dbang gis/ dus zhabs kyi mthong gyer mkhan po 'ga' yis 'di sbyor dgos pa tsam yang rna bas ma thos par snang bas pra khrid las khol du phyung pa yin pas/ phur pa'i rnal 'byor du rloms pa dag gis rtsa ba'i don 'di dor bar ma byed cig /ces pa'ang man ngag zur 'debs 'jam mgon rdo rje 'chang gi gsungs las so//
